r05.

There is no GraphQL schema. The public API is defined as protobuf gRPC services in `proto/api/v1/*.proto` (for example `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`) and exposed through gRPC-Gateway `/api/v1/*` plus Connect handlers, registered in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:95-144`.
